en.details:
How this review was made

Responsible editor
Hyun-Jung Kim
AI system
OpenAI Codex; exact model identifier not retained
Verifiable agent roles
root — primary-source synthesis, Korean writing, original conceptual cover, editing and publication integration; academic_sources — adult human neurogenesis papers, methods and claim-scope audit; rehab_evidence — clinical audit of brain-injury rehabilitation and cell-therapy denominators, endpoints and reported outcomes; full English translation; review_format — original bilingual figures, font typesetting, HTML/PDF production and complete output checks; publish_audit — independent cover, reader-explanation, APS-reference and publication audit
Editorial harness
AI Tech Review Editorial Harness v2026.08 · public method
Inputs and outputs
Public papers, regulatory reviews, rehabilitation guidance and official disclosures → bilingual review, conceptual cover, explanatory figures and PDFs.
Production request
Review evidence for adult human neurogenesis and its relationship to functional recovery and rehabilitation after brain injury.
Verification scope
Accessible sources, versions, samples, methods and reported values; New Scientist was checked through its public introduction, the killifish study through its public abstract, and some Moreno-Jiménez evidence through the abstract and extended figures; original bilingual figures and HTML/PDF output. No independent tissue or single-cell raw-data analysis, clinical trial or rehabilitation treatment.
Human review
Topic, writing and public posting requested; no line-by-line human approval or reader-comprehension study.
Evidence cutoff
2026-10-30

Cell-birth observations, circuit-function studies and clinical endpoints are distinguished. The AI-generated cover is conceptual, not anatomical imaging, cell imaging or a treatment result.
